text: {"defects": ["Product names, unit prices, quantities, and subtotals in the cart table have extremely low contrast (faint light grey text on a white background), making them nearly unreadable.", "The shopping bag icon in the top-right header displays a count of '0' even though there are items (totaling 4 units) in the cart.", "The 'Grand Total' label and amount in the Cart Total section are very faint/faded compared to 'Total products'."]}

defects: Product names, unit prices, quantities, and subtotals in the cart table have extremely low contrast (faint light grey text on a white background), making them nearly unreadable.
The shopping bag icon in the top-right header displays a count of '0' even though there are items (totaling 4 units) in the cart.
The 'Grand Total' label and amount in the Cart Total section are very faint/faded compared to 'Total products'.
